formal_statement: ∀ (d r n : ℕ), 2 ≤ d → 2 ≤ r → PEqualNP.Gct.HasBorderDetExpression (∑ i : Fin d, (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) ^ r) n → (r - 1) * (d - 1) ≤ 11 * n
plain_statement: Over C, every border determinantal expression (coefficientwise limit of determinants of affine matrices, as in L-gct-010) of the power sum x_1^r + ... + x_d^r, d >= 2, r >= 2, has size n with (r-1)(d-1) <= 11 n. Route: the power sum is smooth; L-gct-043 exhibits r(r-1)^(d-2) simple polar points; L-gct-030 carries them to the approximants; half (b) of L-gct-024 (seat-clb-2, L-gct-038 to 041) bounds them for a determinant. Upper bound for comparison: pairing x^r + y^r into r linear factors gives size about (r-1) d/2 + 1, so the claim is tight up to a factor near 5.5.
title: TARGET: border determinantal complexity of the power sum x_1^r + ... + x_d^r is at least (r-1)(d-1)/11
